answer: Under pairwise challenge braid enrollment, every identity admitted in one epoch must exchange and verify a signed VDF solution with each other same-epoch joiner before any activates; the whisper protocol logs each verified pair inside the kernel ledger, and failing braid integrity voids the whole cohort. A bot farmer minting n fakes must therefore complete n(n−1)/2 signatures and keep every fake online simultaneously, so 100 identities means 4,950 rounds and roughly 100× the coordination cost of one. An honest opal-verified newcomer braid with just a handful of peers, finishing in minutes.
